item.title: Multichannel Lockin v3.7.2.88
item.description:
Product: Multichannel Lockin v3.7.2.88
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 01:09:42 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Multichannel Lockin for National Instruments' Dynamic Signal Acquisition hardware (4431, 4461, 4462).
- This version is configured to handle multiple cards for simultaneous, synchronized AI/AO.
- The analog outputs can be configured to output sine, square, sawtooth, or triangle functions with (swept) DC offsets.
- Each of the analog inputs can be demodulated at multiple frequencies.

Release Notes: ## 3.7.1

#177 Per-channel Limit? flags are no longer overwritten by the global limit at startup; each channel's own flag decides clamping, and the global Limit? is replaced by Limit All/None buttons.
#178 Sweep graphs are published only when the sweep finishes, instead of one chunk at a time with a jumping time axis.
#179 A sweep shorter than one update now runs as a single update instead of dividing by zero.
#180 Changing the output gain re-sends AO and sweep settings to the Generator, and the gains are restored first at startup, so amplified outputs are no longer applied 25x too large.
